metadata.title: China and global benchmark electricity-only AI compute cost curves
metadata.notes: The observation cutoff governs displayed values. The research publication cutoff is a provenance freeze and does not change an observation's date.

capacityStandard.label: Commissioned design IT power
capacityStandard.definition: Non-redundant IT or critical-load power that commissioned data-center space is designed to support, excluding cooling and other facility overhead.
capacityStandard.chinaBoundary: Design rack capacity in commissioned computing centers, converted at 2.5 kW per standard rack.
capacityStandard.globalBoundary: Existing or commissioned wholesale data-center power inventory reported by CBRE; treated as critical IT power delivered to the PDU.
capacityStandard.coverageCaveat: The power metric is harmonized, but the market universe is not: China covers all commissioned computing centers captured by CAICT, while CBRE covers wholesale colocation inventory in selected North American markets.

treemap.measurementMethod: Rectangle edges were recorded in pixels from a 160 dpi render. Capacity equals rectangle area divided by the complete treemap area, multiplied by 10.43 million standard racks and 2.5 kW per rack. The 31 rectangles exactly tile the recorded outer bounds.

capacityRecords.note: Design capacity is 442.5 MW. The source's 326 MW campus power figure reflects 60.9% rack utilization and PUE 1.21, so it is not used as design capacity.
Commissioned wholesale inventory; narrower market coverage than the China denominator.

Powered-on racks are not the harmonized commissioned design-capacity metric.

priceRecords.note: Reported delivered green-power transaction price, described as stable at approximately CNY 0.35/kWh.
110 kV two-part, non-time-of-use energy price plus maximum-demand charge at the common 90% load factor.
Jibei is used as the transparent provincial proxy; it is not a province-wide contract price.
Pearl River Delta 35–110 kV two-part tariff applied uniformly as a conservative public proxy; the earlier unsupported 169 MW regional weighting has been removed.
Texas industrial-sector average; not a disclosed data-center contract.
Virginia industrial-sector average; not a disclosed data-center contract.

evidenceScenarios.title: Reported price observations
evidenceScenarios.subtitle: No constructed tariff bills
evidenceScenarios.note: Uses a reported delivered Hohhot price and EIA's reported state industrial averages. Montreal has no qualifying reported price and is omitted.

evidenceScenarios.title: Public-grid-price proxies
evidenceScenarios.subtitle: Constructed tariff bills where available
evidenceScenarios.note: China and Montreal use transparent public-tariff calculations at 90% load factor; Texas and Virginia retain EIA industrial averages because comparable public large-load tariff bills were not constructed.

sources.title: How much green-power demand comes from data centers, and how can supply match it?
